Grand titre · Protects your most precious environmen…
Grand titre · The little choices we make each day ha…
blocks_element.text: The little choices we make each day have a big impact. Toilet paper, tissues, paper towels—these are products we reach for a hundred times a week, in the most intimate ways imaginable. Most of us have never stopped to ask what's actually in them, or what impact they have—on us, our families, our world.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · It starts with the right raw materials…
blocks_element.text:
It starts with the right
raw materials.

blocks_element.repere: Grand titre · We start with 100% FSC-certified carbo…
blocks_element.text: We start with 100% FSC-certified carbon neutral bamboo, primarily from the species neosinocalamus affinis, valued for its unique pulp characteristics which allow it to create a toilet paper of exceptional strength and softness. While most other brands, tree-based and tree-free alike, bleach their pulp to turn it white, PlantPaper uses no bleach or dyes of any kind.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Bamboo is the fastest-growing plant on…
blocks_element.text: Bamboo is the fastest-growing plant on earth, capable of growing up to a meter per day, and sequesters 2-3x more carbon than tree plantations of equivalent size.

blocks_element.repere: Grand titre · Meets a high standard for protecting p…
blocks_element.text: Meets a high standard for protecting people and planet. The world’s first Green Seal certified bamboo toilet paper.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · A marriage of technology and ecology.
Paragraphe · PlantPaper is our response to an indus…
blocks_element.text: PlantPaper is our response to an industry and an hygienic practice in dire need of an update.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · A marriage of technology and ecology.
Grand titre · Most household paper products have bee…
blocks_element.text:
Most household paper products have been made the same way for a century or more. What improvements there have been have mostly benefited the manufacturers, not the people using them.

We set out to put technology in the service of people, not industry–stripping away all that was unnecessary in the manufacturing process.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · A relentless obsession with performanc…
Grand titre · We test obsessively, iterate constantl…
blocks_element.text: We test obsessively, iterate constantly, and hold every roll to the most stringent standards. The result is a sheet that's soft enough to earn the trust of the most sensitive skin, and made in a way that you can actually feel good about.

blocks_element.repere: Grand titre · We’ve done the work so you don’t have …
blocks_element.text: We’ve done the work so you don’t have to. No more schlepping, no more running out. We make it easy to dial in your shipment, so you always have exactly what you need, right when you need it.
